turns.text: Happy Friday, Marcus! How is your day wrapping up in Portland? Have you managed to fit in any tennis lately, or has the science department kept you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's been a busy Friday, but a good one. I didn't play tennis today, but I did manage to squeeze in a workout with some gym weights earlier this afternoon.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great! It sounds like your lower back is still feeling 100% since you recovered from that strain.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, absolutely no issues with the back, thankfully. I've been careful. I actually started my day pretty healthy too, had a protein smoothie for breakfast to fuel up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! A protein smoothie is a great way to kick off a busy day. How are things at school? Is Grace keeping busy too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: School is going well, just the usual administrative stuff for the science department. Grace is doing great, she's actually out with some colleagues tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, so you have the house to yourself tonight! Just you and Olive. Do you have any plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly, just me and the cat. I think I'm just going to relax on the couch and watch some sitcom reruns tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect, low-key Friday night. Have you seen how your neighbor's vegetable garden is doing lately, by the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I saw it yesterday. Their tomatoes are really coming along! It makes me want to grow something, but for now I'll just stick to appreciating theirs.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Haha, definitely easier to enjoy the results without the weeding! I hope you have a wonderful, relaxing evening with those reruns.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm looking forward to a lazy evening. Talk to you tomorrow!
